record.title: Draft Artificial Intelligence Act for creative people (People's Party draft)
record.short_title: Thailand People's Party draft AI Act for creative people
record.issuing_body: People's Party (Culture and Creative Economy wing); not shown as submitted to the House of Representatives
record.summary: Draft AI act prepared by the People's Party to protect the rights of creative workers, presented for comment at a hearing seminar with artists, musicians, writers and designers on 26 July 2026. It rests on three pillars: human in the loop, so that a human always oversees and verifies decisions affecting values or rights; opt-out rights, so that owners may refuse the use of their works or data to train AI unless they give explicit written permission or receive fair compensation; and an AI declaration, requiring works wholly or partly created by AI to be clearly labelled and AI developers to disclose the sources of their training data.
record.notes: The party's Culture and Creative Economy wing held the seminar 'PROMPT THE FUTURE' in Bangkok on 26 July 2026 with People's Party MPs Phuriwat Jaisamran, Naphat Jittapinan-Kanta, Sahasawat Khumkhong and Kantapon Duangamphon. The party said it would incorporate the feedback into the draft and push for a parliamentary subcommittee to study related legal amendments. The government's own draft Act on Artificial Intelligence, prepared by ETDA, is TH-01.
record.scope_note: A political party's draft that had not been introduced in the House of Representatives when it was presented; included, if at all, as a draft private members' bill on AI and creators' rights.

verification.note: CAUTION: rests on one secondary source. Stored: the English edition of Thairath (national newspaper), 26 July 2026, reporting the seminar and the draft's three pillars. No draft text, party page or House of Representatives bill page was found or stored, and nothing shows that the draft has been introduced in Parliament. The Thai title given by the collector, '(ร่าง) พระราชบัญญัติปัญญาประดิษฐ์ (AI) เพื่อคนสร้างสรรค์ ฉบับพรรคประชาชน', is not in a stored copy, so original_title is null.
